remarks: Welcome to 50 Aiken Street #433, a beautifully renovated 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo in Rolling Ridge, one of Norwalk's most well-maintained communities. Step inside to a bright, open-concept living and dining area with a dedicated study space -- all flowing seamlessly to a private balcony perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The kitchen has been completely transformed with brand new LG appliances (dishwasher, electric stove/oven, refrigerator), new cabinets, stainless steel faucet, fresh countertop, and vinyl flooring. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet and shares access to a fully updated bathroom with new toilet, vanity, mirrors, lighting fixtures, and tile flooring. A powder room off the entry provides convenience for guests. Recent upgrades include new carpet, fresh paint throughout, new AC, and updated lighting fixtures -- move-in ready and meticulously cared for. In-unit laundry adds everyday convenience. Rolling Ridge offers resort-style amenities including pool, clubhouse, tennis courts, and dog park, with HOA covering heat, hot water, water, sewer, trash, snow removal, and grounds maintenance. Located just off Main Avenue, you're minutes from restaurants, grocery stores, and everything Norwalk has to offer. This is a rare opportunity to own a fully renovated home in a community that truly delivers.
